modifications: Reorganized selected upstream Ansible content beneath deployment/.
Removed upstream roles and supporting content outside SynthRAN's supported deployment matrix.
Adapted Kubernetes, networking, OAI, Open5GS, free5GC, srsRAN, UERANSIM, reservation, radio-power, and experiment orchestration where SynthRAN requires its own integration.
N3xx physical-radio deployment is intentionally narrowed to the N300 and N320 paths; unsupported O-RAN RU preparation branches and assets are not retained.
For platform=r2lab, selected cleanup, UE connection, OAI N3xx IP-swap, and srsRAN N3xx deployment helper files remain byte-identical to this pinned upstream revision.
SynthRAN adds the Ambient-IoT workload, MQTT transport, collection, logging, reconciliation, and only the minimal adapter needed to run those experiments over the upstream-managed R2Lab UE interface.
comparison_note: The pinned source_commit is authoritative for files listed in upstream_parity. Other retained deployment files are upstream-derived and may be modified by SynthRAN; no test files are retained.
